Love stories about remote island life shaped by geography?  ▶ Watch next:
🌈 *Living in Mapun | How Life Works on the Philippines' Forgotten Border Island*  https://youtu.be/IDcTeoH0Lno
🌈 *Living in Kapingamarangi | How Life Works When Every Drop Must Last* https://youtu.be/OAW7H_FROSU
🧲 Living in the Maldives | How Life Works on Islands with Almost No Land https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c-8qbl4t9CI
➡ Living in Palau | How Life Works When 80% of Its Ocean Is Protected  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T9hjCFTwu0o
Could you see yourself living on an island this narrow, where the sea is your workplace, your road—and sometimes your biggest risk? What would be the hardest part for you: supplies, healthcare, storms, or simply having so little space?
